Professional summary

Final-year Computer Science student with hands-on experience in IT support, data systems and process automation. At ChamStore I support non-technical staff with day-to-day computer issues, maintain accurate records at scale, and build workflows and tracking systems that reduce manual work. Comfortable with PHP/Laravel, SQL and Python, and I have built and documented a ten-project home lab covering Windows Server and Active Directory, identity lifecycle and MFA, endpoint hardening, vulnerability management, network segmentation, backup and disaster recovery, SIEM and IT governance under CIS Controls v8 IG1. Looking for an IT Support Officer or junior System Administrator role.

Technical skills

  • IT Support: hardware and software troubleshooting, PC setup and configuration, user support for non-technical staff, Microsoft 365 apps, documentation and presentations
  • Systems: Windows Server 2025 (AD DS, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy), Active Directory design, OU structure and AGDLP least privilege, file services (DFS-N, ABE, FSRM, shadow copies), identity lifecycle and access governance (joiner-mover-leaver), Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access and MFA, Windows LAPS and privileged access tiering, endpoint hardening (Microsoft security baselines, Defender ASR, BitLocker), patch and vulnerability management (WSUS, careful risk-based prioritisation), backup, recovery and disaster recovery (3-2-1-1-0, immutable copies), network segmentation, VPN and 802.1X Wi-Fi (OPNsense, NPS/RADIUS), SIEM and incident response (Wazuh, Sysmon, MITRE ATT&CK), IT service management and CMDB (GLPI, service catalogue, SLAs), Linux server administration (Ubuntu, AD integration with SSSD), CIS Controls v8 IG1 governance and change management, PowerShell and Bash automation
  • Data & Reporting: advanced Excel / Google Sheets, data cleaning and auditing, record management, reporting for management
  • Programming & Databases: PHP (Laravel), SQL / MySQL, Python, C++

Ten documented home-lab projects (P1–P10) back these skills; the CV lists the three closest to this role, and the full portfolio site covers all ten with evidence.

Projects / home lab

Core Infrastructure Build: AD DS, DNS, DHCP, File Services, GPO and Linux Integration · case study

  • Built a redundant Windows Server 2025 Active Directory foundation for an 85-user simulated company: two replicating domain controllers, AD-integrated DNS and a DHCP failover pair.
  • Implemented AGDLP least-privilege permissions across five departmental shares with DFS-N, Access-Based Enumeration, FSRM quotas and file screens, and wrote a PowerShell ACL audit that enforces it.
  • Automated OU, group and 85-account user provisioning from an HR CSV with idempotent, logged PowerShell, and joined Ubuntu to AD with group-controlled SSH and sudo.

Identity Lifecycle and Access Governance: JML Automation, MFA, Conditional Access, Access Reviews · case study

  • Automated the joiner-mover-leaver lifecycle for an 85-user simulated company from an HR source-of-truth export (PowerShell, keyed on employee ID), with a role matrix that removes old-department access on a move instead of leaving it behind.
  • Built the safety controls a scheduled identity job needs: a -WhatIf preview, a circuit breaker that aborts if more than 10% of accounts would be disabled at once, a protected-accounts list, per-user group snapshots for leavers and an append-only audit log — plus a unit-tested Python reference implementation of the same rules.
  • Implemented hybrid identity (AD to Microsoft Entra ID via Cloud Sync, scoped so admin and service accounts are never synced), Conditional Access policies for MFA and legacy-auth blocking deployed in report-only first with monitored break-glass accounts, and a CISA ScubaGear baseline assessment before and after.

IT Service Desk, Asset Inventory (CMDB) and Documentation Hub · case study

  • Deployed GLPI ITSM on Ubuntu with agent-based asset discovery, LDAP authentication and a weekly reconciliation script that compares the CMDB against DHCP leases and network scans.
  • Built a helpdesk with a service catalogue, business-hours SLAs (TTO/TTR) and an L1 to L2 to vendor escalation matrix, plus a BookStack documentation hub with an owner and review date on every page.
  • Implemented config-as-code: a nightly export of GPO, AD, DHCP, DNS, firewall and NPS configuration to a private Git repository, with drift detection that flags a change lacking an approved change record.
